content.short: Magma Staking provides liquid staking on Monad, issuing a yield-bearing token against staked MON.
content.description: Magma Staking issues a liquid staking token against staked MON so holders keep staking rewards without locking the asset away from DeFi. It is among the earlier liquid staking deployments on Monad, a position that matters because integrations tend to accumulate around whichever token protocols supported first.
content.meta: Stake MON and keep a transferable token, one of the earlier liquid staking options on Monad.
